name: MLC LLM
summary: Universal compiler & on-device inference runtime running quantized open LLMs natively across iOS, Android, Vulkan, Metal, and WebGPU.
ranking_rationale: Runs private offline open-weight LLMs directly on iPhones, Android phones & Apple Silicon via Metal/Vulkan, weighed against smaller curated pre-compiled model list than raw GGUF loaders.

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Runs private offline open-weight LLMs directly on iPhones, Android phones & Apple Silicon via Metal/Vulkan
Zero cloud calls or content-moderation proxies
cons: Smaller curated pre-compiled model list than raw GGUF loaders
Phone RAM limits models to 3B–8B sizes
